knowledgeEntries.answer:
I have worked across supply chain analytics, process automation, and IT systems:

• Amazon (TCMT Support / Operations): Built the Defect Dispute Override (DDO) tool for the TheyPay Carrier Management Team to cut associate defect-research time, and developed SQL + Python network balancing automation.
• AppMinds Inc (IT Analyst): Supported enterprise data workflows, reporting pipelines, and technical troubleshooting.
• DRDL-DRDO (Engineering Intern): Assisted with technical systems analysis and documentation.
I hold a Master of Science in Information Studies from Trine University with a 4.0 GPA, and a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU).

My core technical stack includes:

• Data & ML: Python (95%), SQL & Databases (92%), Process Automation (90%), Data Analysis (88%), Tableau (85%), TensorFlow, and NLP.
• Cybersecurity: Network Security (90%), System Security (88%), Security Tools (85%), and Compliance Frameworks (82%).
• Engineering & Operations: GUI workflow tooling, web scraping, SMTP automation, and cross-team stakeholder collaboration.

Here are four production systems featured in my portfolio:

1. Defect Dispute Override (DDO) Tool: Desktop GUI built for Amazon TCMT that automates carrier appointment defect research.
2. Network Balancing Automation: SQL and Python utility that balances regional freight capacity and eliminates manual spreadsheet reconciliation errors.
3. ATS Resume NLP Analyzer: Client-side NLP resume scorer (/ats) that evaluates keyword alignment and structural completeness.
4. LinkedIn Early Applicant: Automated Python + SMTP job discovery pipeline (/blog/LinkedInnAppDemo).

I hold 13+ verified certifications across Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and Software Development from IBM, Google, Coursera, and LinkedIn Learning — including Foundations of Data Science (Google), Deep Learning with TensorFlow, SQL for Data Analysis, Tableau Essential Training, and the IBM Cybersecurity suite.

I am based in Naperville, IL and open to Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, Business Intelligence, and Process Automation roles.
